en: Black-and-white street scene showing a tree-lined boulevard with a wide pedestrian and cycling path on the left and a cobblestone street bordered by multi‑story brick buildings with shopfronts and awnings on the right. Signs for a café and other businesses are visible. People ride bicycles and walk along the street. Printed caption text at the bottom left identifies the location as Trollhättan, Folkets Hus, Kungsgatan. At the bottom right is a printer/photographer credit.
